title: Grágás (laws of the Icelandic Commonwealth), Landabrigðisþáttur (section on land claims), Icelandic Wikisource
period: 13th-century Old Norse/Old Icelandic law text (Grágás manuscripts c. 1250-1280), printed in modernized Icelandic spelling
notes: License: the medieval text is public domain; the Wikisource page (pinned revision 24446) is published under Wikisource's terms, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Terms_of_Use). The url pins a fixed page revision (oldid), so the bytes do not change. 202,810 bytes; wikitext with little markup (a header template and chapter headings). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'old_norse') gives 177,696 characters. Spelling is normalized to modern Icelandic (og, það), so letter statistics are those of a normalized edition, not of the manuscripts. Kept apart from the modern-Icelandic corpus (M-J-icelandic) by its language name. Caveat for reviewers: the page header gives the edition year as 1992 (the normalized-spelling Grágás edition published in Reykjavík that year); the medieval text itself is public domain and Wikisource hosts this edition under its CC BY-SA terms, but the spelling normalization is a modern editorial act.
